hero.tagline: Design a character's face from structured features, then cast it with AI — consistent, repeatable, and yours to iterate on.

structured.title: Structured faces, not vague prompts
structured.body: Describe a character from dozens of concrete facial features — brow, jaw, eyes, nose, lips, skin — instead of hoping a sentence lands.

casting.title: AI casting images
casting.body: Turn a face spec into consistent, repeatable casting images, ready to drop into a lookbook or pitch.

demographics.title: Demographics & expression
demographics.body: Dial in age, build, expression and health state, then re-render the same character in a new shot or framing.

shots.title: Shots & sizes
shots.body: Choose the shot and image size that fit where the render is going — a headshot, a full figure, a wide plate.

gallery.title: Everything in one gallery
gallery.body: Every generation is saved and browsable, so you can compare takes and come back to the one that worked.

credits.title: Pay only for what you render
credits.body: Start with free credits and top up as you go. No subscription to design a character.
